Name: Happy Birthday
Author: Omegasis
Description:
Ever wonder why you don't have a birthday in Stardew Valley? Well worry no more!

This mods lets you pick a day for your birthday. On your birthday you get letters from your parents, and villagers give you gifts and wish you happy birthday.

[size=4]Updated for SDV 1.6+![/size]
[b][color=#6aa84f]Requires SMAPI 4.0 or later.[/color][/b]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod's Happy Birthday file and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Download a Happy Birthday translated content pack. The English content pack can be found at a separate mods download page [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11148]here[/url]﻿. This is to make sure that Vortex can properly handle downloading the content pack since it didn't work when bundled with the mod.[/*]
[*]Install version 3.0.0+ of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2341]Stardust Core[/url]﻿  as well.﻿[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Usage[/size]
The menu to choose your birthday should appear when you wake up in the morning. On your birthday, talk to NPCs as usual and they'll wish you happy birthday and give you gifts. Their gifts will change based on your friendship with them. Check your mailbox for letters from your parents.

[size=5]FAQ[/size]
[size=3]﻿1. [/size][size=4]Help! Lewis doesn't show up asking me for my birthday and my spouse doesn't ask me for my favorite gift![/size]
﻿  [size=3]﻿- Did you install at least one HappyBirthday content pack? The main one that is supported and created by me can be found at [/size][url=http://]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11148[/url][size=3].[/size]
﻿  [size=3]﻿-Are you playing on Android/IOS? This currently isn't supported as I would need to do some bigger rewrites to support these platforms.
﻿  ﻿-Under the HappyBirthday mod folder is there a data folder that contains your player's birthday? If so, does deleting it fix the problem?
﻿  ﻿-Can you run the SMAPI command (without quotes) in the console to reset the prompt to ask for your birthday? "Omegasis.Happy_Birthday.reset_birthday﻿"[/size]
[size=4]2. Does this mod work on mobile? (Android/IOS)[/size]
﻿  [size=3]-Not currently, no, but I have considered the idea to upgrade it to do so. The biggest constraint would be finding the time to do so and setting up a development environment for it.[/size]
  ﻿[size=4]3. Can you support this mod to make it compatible with (XYZ) mod?[/size]
﻿  [size=3]-There are a lot of mods out there that make changes to NPCs, maps, etc that make it hard to keep compatibility with them all. As much as I would love to be able to make this mod compatible with all of them, I unfortunately don't have the time to do so. There may be a few chosen bigger mods that would have some varying degree of compatibility support (such as Stardew Valley Expanded), but those would be decided on a case-by-case basis.[/size]
[size=4]﻿4. Can I make a content pack for this mod and upload it myself?[/size]
  ﻿  [size=3]﻿-Absolutely, and please do!
﻿5. NPCs don't give me birthday gifts! Is the mod broken?
﻿  ﻿-NPCs will only give you gifts if you have at least two hearts with them by default. This can be changed in the mod's config file to require more or less hearts with NPCs.
﻿  [size=3]- Did you install at least one HappyBirthday content pack? The main one that is supported and created by me can be found at [/size][url=http:]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11148[/url][size=3].[/size][/size]

[size=5]New in Version 3.0.0[/size]
[list]
Major Changes
[*]Villagers who did not give a gift/birthday wishes on the day of the Player's birthday will send a letter with said belated wishes and gifts instead. No more hunting everyone down![/*]
[*]Players are no longer asked their birthday when starting the game. Instead Lewis has an event outside the farmhouse where he will ask you.[/*]
[*]Players are no longer asked their favorite gift when starting the game. Instead their spouse will have an event with them when they are married and ask them instead, which aligns more with the original intent of the spouse being the one to give the player their favorite gift.
[size=4]Added new birthday events.[/size][/*]
[*]Community birthday party: Go to the saloon when you have 5+ hearts with all of the villagers for a nice surprise. :)[/*]
[*]Spouse specific birthday events: All spouses have a special birthday event where they wish you happy birthday and give you your favorite gift! Includes extra dialogue outside of the original dialogue present.[/*]
[*]Joja also recognizes the birthdays of their members, but only available as long as they are still in town.[/*]
[*]Birthday events are now saved to .json files so that they can be modified in the case of a random conflict of some sorts (I.E npcs getting stuck on modded maps)
[size=4]Minor Changes[/size][/*]
[*]The Junimos will now have their birthday party at the Community Center for the player regardless if it is finished or not. Just don't be a Joja member![/*]
[*]Mom and dad's birthday gifts can now be adjusted in the config file for the mod.[/*]
[*]Dad gives less money during year 1 and 5k during year 2+.[/*]
[*]Added birthday wishes for Leo.
[size=4]Quality of Life[/size][/*]
[*]Added a search box to the Gift Selector Menu.[/*]
[*]Added tool tip hover boxes to the Gift Selector Menu.
[size=4]Modding[/size][/*]
[*]Rewrote the gift and birthday wishes systems to use a content pack format for Happy Birthday. This means that adding custom NPCs via content packs should be MUCH easier as only an entry for their gifts and dialogue need to be added. See below for more details
[size=4]Bug Fixes:[/size][/*]
[*]Farmhands no longer need to reselect their birthday when rebooting the game. (I know this was a huge bug report)[/*]
[*]Prevent users from being able to select their birthday on festival days. This was originally present but somehow broke when updating the mod once. Willing to remove this if someone requests it since now Players can get birthday wishes in the mail the next day. :)[/*]
[/list]


[size=5]Advanced: Content Packs[/size]
As of Happy Birthday 3.21.0, Content Patcher is now supported! I highly recommend checking the readme for understanding how it works and how to make content packs with it! [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/ContentPatcher#readme]https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/ContentPatcher#readme[/url]

I recommend reading the Happy Birthday Content Pack (version 2.0.0+) at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11148]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11148[/url] to understand how the content pack is structured.

There are a few key things to note here as well.
1. The structure of the files does not matter. Content Patcher looks for a content.json file to load in content. You can have all of your data in that file, or break it up using Content Patcher's Include Actions. [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/develop/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide/action-include.md]https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/develop/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide/action-include.md[/url]
2. There are a couple of places where the mod, HappyBirthday expects specific formatted entries for things such as mail for belated birthday wishes or gifts.
2.1: Belated Birthday Wishes (Mail give the day after a Player's Birthday): To add a new belated birthday wish for a custom NPC you would need the following in your content.json file where you replace the NPC_Name with your custom NPC's code name/id. The entry key [b]must[/b] start with Omegasis.HappyBirthday_BelatedBirthdayWish_ for the mod to recognize it as a valid belated birthday wish.

//Mail
{
  "Action": "EditData",
  "Target": "Data/Mail",
  "entries": {
    "Omegasis.HappyBirthday_BelatedBirthdayWish_NPC_Name ": "Replace this with some custom belated birthday wish."
  }
}

2.2: Birthday Wishes: To add a new birthday wish for your custom NPC, you will need to add the following to your content.json file. Note that the expected key here is [b]Omegasis.HappyBirthday.BirthdayGreeting[/b]. If you don't have this entry, the mod will instead have the NPC say a generic birthday greeting instead.
{
"Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "Characters/Dialogue/NPC_Name",
      "entries": {
        "Omegasis.HappyBirthday.BirthdayGreeting": "Replace this with a birthday wish for the player"
      }
    }
  ]
}

2.3. Adding a specific list of gifts for your NPC requires you adding something similar to your content.json file. The "Target" parameter is the expected gift file. This always begins with  Mods/Omegasis.HappyBirthday/Gifts/ and you replace NPC_Name with the name of your custom NPC. Inside the entries, table, the format is "QualifiedItemId" : "MinAmountOfItemToGive MaxAmountOfItemToGive". If the  MinAmountOfItemToGive and  MaxAmountOfItemToGive values are different, a random value between those two numbers will be chosen.
{
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "Mods/Omegasis.HappyBirthday/Gifts/NPC_Name",
      "entries": {
        "StardewValley.Object.Quartz": "5 5",
        "SomeQualifiedItemId": "MinAmount MaxAmount",
      }
    },
  ]
}


The old content packs should still be supported from my testing, but if any bugs have popped up, please let me know!
﻿


[size=5]Advanced: Adding in translations[/size]

[size=3]With the inclusion for mods to add in custom translations now, the content pack system also servers as the translation content system as well. Only a few adjustments need to be made when adding a new translation for vanilla content

1.All files under <ContentPackMainFolder>/Content/Strings/ will need to be modified for the new translation. This will include birthday wishes, mail, event dialogue etc.
2. <ContentPackMainFolder>/TranslationInfo.json will need to be changed to have it's "LanguageCode" field to reflect the translation code the game is using. So for example adding in a Spanish translation would require changing the language code in the new content pack to "LanguageCode": "es-ES"[/size]

[size=3]This should allow it to be much much easier for users to be able to add in custom translations, or variations of dialogue without needing to send me the information anymore. Just make a content pack and drag and drop it into the StardewValley/Mods folder and you should be all good! Happy Birthday will automatically load it in for you![/size]


[size=5]Regarding Content Packs:[/size]

[size=3]Please feel free to release content packs under your own user profile. I will not be including translation content packs under the downloads section for this mod anymore, instead it would make me happy to see others get proper credit for the work they put in as well. If you make a content pack, absolutely go ahead and sign up for Nexus's mod donations point system! [/size]

[size=5]Regarding Mod Support:[/size]
[size=3]I know it's been widely requested to add support for popular mods like Stardew Valley Expanded. I have added a lot of structure to be able to do so now, but I still need to do investigation for what specifically needs to be done, plus writing events/dialogue, etc for these new NPCs. I haven't played with that mod myself, so I can't promise anything for this in the immediate future, but it is still something I would like to do.

For now, if there is an interest in modding expansions for Happy Birthday, there is additional support for doing things such as adding custom items to be given from mods for the Player's birthday, adding in custom events, and expanding on event capabilities. To see what is possible, please see 
https://github.com/janavarro95/Stardew_Valley_Mods/blob/DevelopmentModRewrites/GeneralMods/HappyBirthday/Framework/API/HappyBirthdayAPI.cs
and[/size]
[size=3]https://github.com/janavarro95/Stardew_Valley_Mods/tree/DevelopmentModRewrites/GeneralMods/HappyBirthday/Framework/Events
for more information.[/size]

[size=5]Regarding Bugs:[/size]
[size=3]If there is a bug for the mod please post in the Bugs section for this mod page so I can take note and address it. It will help me see what still needs to be fixed. While I tested as much as possible for this new version, I know there probably are a few things I overlooked working some late nights on this, so please be patience and bring it to my attention.[/size]

[size=5]Closing Notes:[/size]
[size=3]It's been over 5 years since I released Happy Birthday, part of a hobby experiment to get properly into video game design. While I know I haven't always been the most active, it's been great interacting with the community, seeing your feedback, and reading about how much others have enjoyed my work. It never was my intention to become as popular as I did, but I am glad if I helped you experience Stardew Valley in a positive way. Thanks for the journey and best of wishes as always. :)[/size]

Omegasis.
